comments.body: 2026-10-24: fixed on main in b76817b6, with a test that failed before the fix. A post to an idle agent already woken rings it again (MIP-4 section 5 now says so); a wake already on its way is left alone. Not checked in a real Codex pane.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-10-21 about 21:52-22:01 CDT on the Mac mini, Muster 0.16.2-dev, from tooling feedback. An integrator typed /new into a Codex worker's pane (bunx @openai/codex@0.162.1) and posted a new brief. The worker still had one unread message from before /new, whose wake had been typed into the old session. The post printed `woke: cumin (p2dgy9mk4b, idle, already woken)`, nothing was typed into the pane, and Codex sat idle at its empty prompt for 9 minutes. A second post 9 minutes later printed the same and rang nothing. `muster pane send` reached the agent at once.

So a participant's woken state outlives the session it was true for: /new discarded the typed wake, and nothing told the daemon. `unwake` in `crates/muster-msg/src/service.rs` forgets a wake only when it never reached the pane. Not checked against 0.18.0.

Possibly: forget a participant's woken state when its pane's session changes (/new, /clear, a restart), or ring again an idle pane whose prompt is empty while it still has unread messages. The same is likely true of Claude Code's /clear; unchecked.
title: A post after /new in a Codex pane finds it 'already woken' and rings nothing
